purpose: Requirement-based review manifest; case count is not a completion metric. Candidates are proposals, not authorized implementation priorities.

status_semantics.green: Last retained native comparison passed within stated scope
status_semantics.known-red: Last retained report matches exact reviewed failure policy; test exists, implementation defect remains
status_semantics.audit first: Identify missing protection and independent expectation before implementing
status_semantics.worth implementing: Concrete integration/behaviour gap; expectation and stopping rule stated
status_semantics.skip: No distinct protection or original requirement established

implemented_families.title: Continuous core replays
implemented_families.behaviour: Serve and continuous R1/R2 state, event order and transitions
implemented_families.regression: Arithmetic, update-order, scoring or dispatch drift
implemented_families.independent_expectation: Frozen repeated original callback records
implemented_families.stopping_condition: Retain uninterrupted comparisons through their defined endings; known failures remain explicit
implemented_families.limits: Baseline runs may stop at first known error; full-match references are not proof of full native parity

implemented_families.title: Local wait/resume/restart phases
implemented_families.behaviour: Tail dispatch and independent resumed/restarted gameplay
implemented_families.regression: Wrong callback regime or state reset
implemented_families.independent_expectation: Slices validated against original continuous parents
implemented_families.stopping_condition: One continuous comparison per distinct regime
implemented_families.limits: One-time local initialization does not establish upstream continuity
implemented_families.worth: keep as diagnostics; review overlap with I06

implemented_families.title: Deuce/advantage scoring
implemented_families.behaviour: Deuce, advantage gained/lost/regained and game award
implemented_families.regression: Wrong scoring transition or accumulated point state
implemented_families.independent_expectation: Original continuous deuce sequence and five boundary records
implemented_families.stopping_condition: Existing continuous sequence plus boundary localization
implemented_families.limits: Short boundary cases overlap sequence; do not add equivalent variants

implemented_families.title: Timer saturation
implemented_families.behaviour: Reachable shared/status counter saturation
implemented_families.regression: Wrapping instead of saturating or wrong audio cadence
implemented_families.independent_expectation: Original reachable timer-boundary snapshots
implemented_families.stopping_condition: Retain full-state failure and restricted timer diagnostic separately
implemented_families.limits: Restricted counter observation cannot establish full-state parity

implemented_families.title: Lower receiver local movement
implemented_families.behaviour: Receiver limits after side exchange behind an earlier failure
implemented_families.regression: Wrong bound or movement direction on later receiver
implemented_families.independent_expectation: Original natural approach/hold/reversal phase
implemented_families.stopping_condition: Existing four directional comparisons
implemented_families.limits: Supplement continuous parents; do not replace them

implemented_families.title: Complete local awards and result regimes
implemented_families.behaviour: Award through wait/reset or result/menu/restart
implemented_families.regression: Missing main-thread work, wrong waits, reset or handoff
implemented_families.independent_expectation: Validated original uninterrupted award intervals
implemented_families.stopping_condition: Both modes and both round ends plus result/restart intervals
implemented_families.limits: Local starts; native hardware and ordinary continuity checked separately

implemented_families.title: Independent later serve handoffs
implemented_families.behaviour: Resumed, upper, restarted and AI-launched serve completion
implemented_families.regression: Wrong serve timer/phase, flight or handoff
implemented_families.independent_expectation: Original later serve phases
implemented_families.stopping_condition: Existing distinct serve contexts
implemented_families.limits: AI phase begins after launch; does not establish launch correctness

implemented_families.title: Movement bounds
implemented_families.behaviour: Both players, four bound rows, four directions with approach/hold/reversal
implemented_families.regression: Off-by-one limits, reversed directions, failure to resume
implemented_families.independent_expectation: Original direct movement-entry/return snapshots
implemented_families.stopping_condition: All 32 player/row/direction combinations already represented
implemented_families.limits: Some continuous parents fail earlier; I05 independently exposes lower receiver

implemented_families.title: Consecutive two-player rally
implemented_families.behaviour: Six accepted returns followed by intentional miss/point
implemented_families.regression: Contact or trajectory drift accumulated across successive returns
implemented_families.independent_expectation: Original legitimate control sequence
implemented_families.stopping_condition: Existing consecutive rally including both return paths and point
implemented_families.limits: Does not establish physical Amiga input latency or pixels

implemented_families.title: Upper return action boundary
implemented_families.behaviour: Before/at/after action timing around an accepted upper return
implemented_families.regression: Action gate changes completed shot or accepts action at wrong epoch
implemented_families.independent_expectation: Repeated original action timing captures
implemented_families.stopping_condition: Three variants and targeted action-gate mutation already sufficient
implemented_families.limits: Do not generalise to lower player or geometric edges

implemented_families.title: Continuous restart extensions
implemented_families.behaviour: Preserve original full match and extend to restarted serve release
implemented_families.regression: Restart loses state or chooses wrong serve phase
implemented_families.independent_expectation: Prefix-validated original replay extensions
implemented_families.stopping_condition: Both modes through restarted handoff
implemented_families.limits: Early native error may block continuous comparison; local phases remain separate

implemented_families.title: Sprite and initial field presentation
implemented_families.behaviour: Title, sprite placement, lower moving prefix, upper serve and score/status prefix
implemented_families.regression: Wrong sprite origin, generation, ball placement or field bank
implemented_families.independent_expectation: Original completed rasters with callback/hardware association
implemented_families.stopping_condition: Named launch/flight/point/expiry checkpoints and distinct upper serve
implemented_families.limits: Court outcome images remain conditional; do not duplicate general sprite-origin protection

implemented_families.title: First-serve Paula output
implemented_families.behaviour: Pitch conversion, measured envelope, hardware and emitted mute
implemented_families.regression: Wrong period/table, residual sound or disconnected waveform
implemented_families.independent_expectation: Frozen original PSG events and measured WAV
implemented_families.stopping_condition: Existing pitch/envelope known reds and mute signal/silence controls
implemented_families.limits: No exact onset/decay, later effects or complete waveform fidelity claim

implemented_families.title: Initial physical input decoding
implemented_families.behaviour: Both ports directions/buttons, simultaneous input, held/released samples
implemented_families.regression: Wrong port bit or omitted second reader
implemented_families.independent_expectation: Repeated original physical-control calibration
implemented_families.stopping_condition: Existing 13 windows with actual executable fault detection
implemented_families.limits: Reader/normalisation checks do not establish game response, exchanged sides or latency

implemented_families.title: Field renderer units
implemented_families.behaviour: Score/game/status/mode selectors, inactive bank and blanking swaps
implemented_families.regression: Wrong glyph/selector, corruption outside field or front-bank mutation
implemented_families.independent_expectation: Original field rasters; six shared-font contexts explicitly distinguished
implemented_families.stopping_condition: Existing selector inventory and zero/adjacent-selector faults
implemented_families.limits: No game callbacks; shared-font rows are not captured game scenes

implemented_families.title: Status lifecycles
implemented_families.behaviour: Live appearance/expiry for all six messages (first in prefix)
implemented_families.regression: Clear early, retain after expiry or wrong requested status
implemented_families.independent_expectation: Original point-driven requests and completed crops
implemented_families.stopping_condition: Existing distinct status appearances and expiries
implemented_families.limits: Local cases; second-reader failure retained independently

implemented_families.title: Deuce/advantage field transitions
implemented_families.behaviour: Actual point requests and completed fields across equal/advantage changes
implemented_families.regression: Draw a callback early or freeze one field behind existing error
implemented_families.independent_expectation: Original draw-boundary records and completed score pixels
implemented_families.stopping_condition: Existing deuce/advantage/return-to-deuce transitions
implemented_families.limits: Simulation scoring covered separately by I03

implemented_families.title: Round hardware scenes
implemented_families.behaviour: Award tally, reset pause, final pause and resumed display in four contexts
implemented_families.regression: Late stale score/sprites, missing reset or wrong event consumption
implemented_families.independent_expectation: Original full viewports and consecutive state/event observations
implemented_families.stopping_condition: Four distinct mode/end contexts with late compiled faults
implemented_families.limits: Local initialization, known placement/reset errors; stop equivalent scenes

implemented_families.title: Ordinary physical mode selection
implemented_families.behaviour: No active gameplay before choice; Delete/Tab select modes
implemented_families.regression: Bypass title, ignore two-player choice or keep wrong mode
implemented_families.independent_expectation: Original pre-choice and accepted-mode states; physical native requests
implemented_families.stopping_condition: Both requests expose gating/acceptance errors; aligned final image still open
implemented_families.limits: Timed final image diagnostic while native acceptance absent; callback count is not gameplay

implemented_families.title: Result/title/restart hardware scenes
implemented_families.behaviour: Local match award through title, physical selection and restarted flight
implemented_families.regression: Stale result/title/court, lost physical edge, reset or sound event
implemented_families.independent_expectation: Original validated extensions with completed rasters and event stream
implemented_families.stopping_condition: Both modes plus late sprite/field/refresh faults
implemented_families.limits: Local interval and logical PSG events; not whole-match cadence or Paula waveform

candidates.title: Lower return action timing
candidates.plausible_regression: Using upper action rule or sampling action a callback late
candidates.independent_expectation: Original reachable lower contact with legitimate before/at/after action captures
candidates.stopping_condition: Distinct original action outcomes and subsequent flight compared; equivalent outcomes share one case
candidates.existing_overlap: I09 covers ordinary lower returns; I10 only upper action edge
candidates.implementation_work: Focused source capture and existing core runner extension
candidates.dependencies: Existing I09 rally and I10 action-boundary harness

candidates.title: Serve action acceptance
candidates.missing_behaviour: Held/released/early action acceptance around serve handoff
candidates.plausible_regression: Premature launch, stuck serve or double acceptance
candidates.independent_expectation: Original serve phases and, only if absent, adjacent legitimate action timings
candidates.stopping_condition: Every distinct serve action outcome protected through first flight
candidates.existing_overlap: I01/I07 already cover several serves; identify absent outcome before capture

candidates.title: Geometric contact edge
candidates.missing_behaviour: Adjacent reachable hit/miss positions at contact
candidates.independent_expectation: Original legitimate adjacent player positions; hit/miss and point records
candidates.stopping_condition: One pair per genuinely distinct lower/upper contact rule
candidates.existing_overlap: I09 accepts returns but does not deliberately bracket collision bounds
candidates.implementation_work: Source edge discovery and core comparisons
candidates.evidence_readiness: New reachable edge evidence likely needed
candidates.dependencies: C04 contact/outcome inventory and reachable legitimate controls

candidates.title: Court outcome to point attribution
candidates.missing_behaviour: Distinct bounce/net/out rule effects and eventual winning player
candidates.plausible_regression: Wrong bounce count, net reflection, out classification or scorer
candidates.stopping_condition: Index distinct outcomes; add comparison only when existing state streams or fault controls miss one
candidates.existing_overlap: I01/I09 carry state/points; first mismatch can conceal later outcomes
candidates.implementation_work: Map event to trajectory/flags/point, then choose missing local interval
candidates.evidence_readiness: Original full records present; semantic indexing incomplete
candidates.dependencies: Audit I01/I09 full-state extent and local-failure masking

candidates.title: Random decisions affecting play
candidates.plausible_regression: Ignoring entropy or applying its sign to wrong target
candidates.independent_expectation: Original consumed refresh choices and following reachable target/flight state
candidates.stopping_condition: Distinct observed effects linked to existing comparisons; add only meaningful absent outcome
candidates.existing_overlap: I01/I07 compare state; observing both bits alone insufficient
candidates.implementation_work: Index choice-to-effect and use declared entropy seam only if necessary
candidates.evidence_readiness: Existing records present; effect mapping incomplete
candidates.dependencies: Map original entropy to actual target/trajectory consumers

candidates.title: Physical input causes player/action response
candidates.missing_behaviour: Actual native control changes gameplay, not just decoded bits
candidates.plausible_regression: Correct reader output but wrong consumer/player/action
candidates.independent_expectation: Original control calibration plus reachable movement/serve/contact outcomes
candidates.stopping_condition: Representative direction/reversal/action response per distinct consumer; no exhaustive repeated bit matrix
candidates.existing_overlap: I14 ends at readers; I08/I09 inject core inputs
candidates.implementation_work: Extend actual hardware capture to consequent state
candidates.evidence_readiness: Original components present; combined windows need definition
candidates.dependencies: I14 physical calibration; preserve known second-reader defect

candidates.title: Physical control ownership after side exchange
candidates.missing_behaviour: Pads control correct players after round exchange
candidates.plausible_regression: Keep initial pad ownership or swap twice
candidates.independent_expectation: Original later movement and round records with pad ownership
candidates.stopping_condition: Each distinct ownership regime has a physical response comparison
candidates.existing_overlap: I05 core phase and I14 initial ownership do not close integration
candidates.implementation_work: One continuous or explicitly local physical exchanged-side window
candidates.evidence_readiness: Original later states present; native physical window needed
candidates.dependencies: C06 response harness and original exchanged-side record

candidates.title: Input sample boundary and latency
candidates.missing_behaviour: Input edge consumed on correct source update independent of presentation
candidates.plausible_regression: Sample twice, lose an edge, or tie action to video frame
candidates.independent_expectation: Original input-read epochs and source schedule; explicit Amiga host mapping
candidates.stopping_condition: Before/after edges for distinct direction/action consumers and bounded latency under ordinary scheduling
candidates.existing_overlap: I10 source-core edge; I14 sustained physical windows
candidates.implementation_work: Ordinary capture with timed physical edge; define epoch/latency criterion
candidates.evidence_readiness: Epoch mapping and precise edge scheduling needed
candidates.dependencies: C09 clock mapping; precise physical edge scheduling

candidates.title: Ordinary callback cadence and deadline
candidates.missing_behaviour: Correct source-rate gameplay/tail/result callbacks during ordinary execution
candidates.plausible_regression: One callback per PAL frame, accumulate drift, skip/update twice, slow wait
candidates.independent_expectation: Retained original timing baseline and regime intervals
candidates.stopping_condition: All distinct regimes plus long interval agree with defined source-rate schedule and no unexplained lateness
candidates.existing_overlap: Local debugger captures deliberately do not establish cadence
candidates.implementation_work: Read-only timing instrumentation of ordinary executable, source-rate and deadline assertions
candidates.evidence_readiness: Source timing evidence present; ordinary native measurement required
candidates.dependencies: Source timing baseline; ordinary executable trace without single-step scheduling

candidates.title: Ordinary complete-match continuity
candidates.missing_behaviour: No visible-line commit or stale/lost graphics/sound across sustained run and restart
candidates.plausible_regression: Prepare too slowly, publish incomplete state, lose event or leak state across round
candidates.independent_expectation: Original R1/R2 event/state progression; Amiga blanking hardware invariant
candidates.stopping_condition: Both control modes cover award, wait, resume, result and restart with deadlines and no visible commits
candidates.existing_overlap: I18/I20 local scenes; I01 may stop early
candidates.implementation_work: Ordinary run with compact commit/event trace; retain checkpoints rather than every frame
candidates.evidence_readiness: Original progression present; native run can expose current known failures
candidates.dependencies: C09 trace and C11 sound-class inventory; current product failures remain recorded

candidates.title: Remaining sound event classes
candidates.plausible_regression: Wrong event dispatch/channel, truncated result phrase or missing resumed sound
candidates.independent_expectation: Retained original named audio intervals and PSG streams
candidates.stopping_condition: First inventory distinct event/envelope/channel combinations; one actual output comparison per unique class
candidates.existing_overlap: I13 first serve; I20 logical PSG does not prove Paula output
candidates.implementation_work: Group retained 18 intervals by actual effect and extend audio runner
candidates.evidence_readiness: Original recordings present; effect grouping and native windows needed
candidates.dependencies: Inventory retained original audio intervals; no prerequisite product fixes

candidates.title: Sound onset and duration
candidates.missing_behaviour: Sound begins/ends in relation to source event schedule
candidates.plausible_regression: Delayed audio update, skipped phrase or extra tail after transition
candidates.independent_expectation: Original timed commands and measured audible boundaries
candidates.stopping_condition: Distinct scheduling regimes have defined onset/end criteria with justified clock/sample mapping
candidates.existing_overlap: I13 signal/silence has wide windows; not exact onset/decay proof
candidates.implementation_work: Align audio samples to event trace and measure boundaries before asserting tolerance
candidates.evidence_readiness: Original audio present; exact native sample/clock alignment needed
candidates.dependencies: C09 clock mapping and C11 effect inventory

candidates.title: Emitted pitch/envelope and waveform fidelity
candidates.missing_behaviour: Audible conversion matches intended pitch/relative envelope beyond registers
candidates.plausible_regression: Wrong waveform period/content, level handling or quantization
candidates.independent_expectation: Measured original WAV plateaus/frequency plus explicit native clock and integer quantization
candidates.stopping_condition: Independent waveform measurements reject pitch/level/data faults for distinct relevant effects
candidates.existing_overlap: I13 register pitch/envelope known reds; bounded presence alone weak
candidates.implementation_work: Extend existing audio cases with actual measurements and documented mapping
candidates.evidence_readiness: Original and first native WAVs present; fidelity criterion needs definition
candidates.dependencies: Existing I13 audio measurements and explicit waveform mapping

candidates.title: Stereo routing/filter policy
candidates.missing_behaviour: Documented native channel balance and filter treatment
candidates.plausible_regression: Accidentally silent side, cancellation, or unintended filtering
candidates.independent_expectation: Original mono output and explicit intended Amiga mapping; original alone cannot prescribe stereo
candidates.stopping_condition: Agree presentation policy, then test channel contributions and stable filter behaviour once
candidates.existing_overlap: I13 per-channel silence prevents cancellation but does not specify balance
candidates.implementation_work: Choose fidelity policy before measuring acceptance
candidates.evidence_readiness: Design decision needed; do not invent source-equivalent stereo requirement

candidates.title: Generation-aligned accepted-mode image
candidates.missing_behaviour: Accepted physical mode produces correct stable mode/court display
candidates.plausible_regression: Correct flag with stale title or wrong mode image
candidates.independent_expectation: Original accepted-mode generation and completed raster
candidates.stopping_condition: Extend both existing mode cases to aligned accepted image with stale/wrong-mode control
candidates.existing_overlap: I19 exposes selection failures; its timed final screenshot is diagnostic
candidates.implementation_work: Extend existing cases, not add two duplicate selection cases
candidates.evidence_readiness: Original image present; native acceptance absent is known failure, not excuse to claim coverage
candidates.dependencies: Extend I19; classify missing acceptance as known red

candidates.title: Return/bounce/net/out rendering
candidates.missing_behaviour: Specific ball/frame/shadow update unique to outcome event
candidates.plausible_regression: Only if named: freeze post-contact ball, wrong reflected frame, or stale shadow while earlier sprites remain correct
candidates.independent_expectation: Original uploaded sprite/VDP state and associated event/next completed raster
candidates.stopping_condition: For each unique missing render transition, prove targeted late fault rejection; skip if current images catch it
candidates.existing_overlap: I12/I18 catch generic sprite origin and stale generations; I09 core trajectories
candidates.implementation_work: Inspect current render contract and checkpoints first, reuse original media
candidates.evidence_readiness: Original event rasters present; unique missing fault not yet established
candidates.dependencies: Audit I12/I18 checkpoint protection; name an escaping render fault

candidates.title: More movement, upper timing, status, round, result and mute variants
candidates.stopping_condition: Reopen only with named distinct regression escaping current tests
candidates.evidence_readiness: Sufficient existing variants; no new evidence needed
candidates.dependencies: None unless new distinct fault escapes current protection

candidates.title: Active noise effect
candidates.missing_behaviour: No active gameplay noise requirement observed
candidates.plausible_regression: Invented effect would test behaviour not present in game
candidates.independent_expectation: Retained original R1/R2 audio noise remains muted
candidates.stopping_condition: Reopen only if actual original audible noise is discovered
candidates.existing_overlap: Original audio inventory explicitly records muted noise
candidates.evidence_readiness: No original evidence for active effect

support_checks.name: Original ROM assembly round trip
support_checks.limit: Not gameplay meaning or native port acceptance; no fresh result asserted here

support_checks.name: Reference integrity and source-derived phase validation
support_checks.protects: Oracles retain original provenance, prefix/phase correspondence and event associations
support_checks.limit: Validation is supporting evidence, not a new gameplay test

support_checks.name: Failure policy and actual executable controls
support_checks.protects: Known early failures do not conceal protected later changes; comparators reject faults
support_checks.limit: Controls have declared scopes; not every historical case has complete-observation digest or real fault control
